evidence_type: DETERMINISTIC_ANALYTICAL_SIMULATION (calibrated to measured D2 evidence; no network I/O)

regime_family.type: two-phase slow->fast (anchored to the measured D2 mechanism)
regime_family.note: The exact D2 3-phase schedule (640/160/2500 KiB/s at 2 s/4 s) is a validation anchor only, not part of the adaptation-value family.

primary_one_switch.signal: median of the last 3 observed completed-request throughput samples
primary_one_switch.baseline: median of the first 3 observed samples (established before any transition information exists)

diagnostic_probe_two_switch.rule: at the first completion switch to (16, 256 KiB); once the recent throughput rises above the pre-switch baseline, switch to the joint target
diagnostic_probe_two_switch.labelled: diagnostic extension, not the primary design

blind_ramp.rule: one predeclared time-based switch at t in {1..8 s} to any action-space target (no performance signal)
blind_ramp.labelled: diagnostic; the full scan is an oracle over the ramp parameters (an upper bound for the time-based class)

optimistic_causal_bound.rule: start (4,4M) until the first completion (the earliest observation-triggered action point); from there allow clairvoyant exact-time switches (first completion and, if later, the true transition T) over the action space + frontier
optimistic_causal_bound.labelled: diagnostic upper bound for observation-triggered controllers

oracle.rule: clairvoyant exact-time single switch over start actions/times/targets

aria2_reference.model: 16 pieces of 32 MiB issued at ~0.405 s, each held at its start rate (no client abort; --timeout is a connection timeout)

predeclared_gate.G1_fixed_optimum_varies: per-regime argmin differs and the max wrong-config penalty >= 5%
predeclared_gate.G2_positive_causal_headroom: some predeclared causal controller beats the per-regime best fixed by >= 5% in >= 2 regimes
predeclared_gate.G3_beats_aria2: the same causal controller beats aria2 in the same regimes
predeclared_gate.G4_no_stationary_gain: no causal gain (>= 2%) in the stationary controls
predeclared_gate.overall: PASS iff G1 and G2 and G3 and G4; otherwise STOP and no empirical execution
